required_span_coverage: Each required span needs one valid citation in the same identified source and revision containing the entire required interval. A whole-source citation can cover several paragraphs. Disjoint/gapped unions never establish coverage; no bridging source IDs or revisions.
submission_equality: Exact UTF-8 bytes of answer.json must equal the sole complete observed plaintext final message. No parsing, trimming, newline insertion/removal, JSON reserialization or substitution. Save answer.json without a terminal LF and return its exact contents. A mismatch is a separate observed protocol failure, retained without retry or repair.
evaluation_visibility: The oracle, gold obligations, checker controls and other-arm outputs are evaluator-only. Receivers may access only their declared source/package/interface/dependency paths and their new answer path by protocol. This is not filesystem confinement; hidden access and backend plaintext dispatch equality remain UNKNOWN.
assessment_masking: The assessor receives anonymized first-answer bytes, the same original-source oracle and frozen rubric; no arm mapping or execution trace. Narrative details may reveal an arm. Masking is protocol-only, not proven blinding or independent model errors.
selection: Full existing SC_MAIN task retained: controller external definitions/maintenance, both reviews, approval history/revocation and attributed uncertain quantity. No invented pending correction. No other fixture cases added or removed from existing suites.
